page.layout: One column of dictionary text on a single printed page; running head "E L." centred at top; page number 237 at top right. Catchword "Elices," at the foot right. No margin notes. A brace grouping two lines with "corpore mica salis." in the middle of the text.

main_text.p: Elargiri alicui] Totum se in aliquem profundere. Largitiones maximas facere. Ærarium vel patrimonium effundere in aliquem, Cic. Si ignotis impertit, eluet facilius, Iun.
Electio] Electus necis,Ov. Lectio senatus, Suet. Optio, Cic.
Electio plurium] Calculis omnium. Plurium calculus vicit.
Electus] Selectus. Cunctorum suffragiis factus consul, Cic. Optivus, Hor.
Eleemosyna] Stips, Ovid. Sportula, Rader. Collecta, Id. Collatitia, vel Collectitia pecunia. Collatitia stips, Amm.
Elegans] Excultus homo, omni vitâ & cultu lautus, mundus homo, Politus, Cic. Lautiusculus, Apul. Praetersus, Plaut. Excuratus homo, Id. A Deo factus. Concinnus. Scitus, Cic.
Eleganter] Pereleganter. Enucleatè & Atticè, Cic. Lautè, munditer vestitus, Plaut. Conversè, Cat. Purgatè. Non. Mundulè, Apul. Mundè, Titinn.
Elegantia] Munditia. Vitae cultus cum elegantia & copiâ delectat, Cic. Mundities, Catul. Lautitia, est munditia in vestitu & cibo, Plin.
Elegantia sermonis] Atticus sal. Vid. Sermo elegans.
Non est in tanto } corpore mica salis. Nulla in tam magno est }
Elementa] Prima, genitalia corpora, Lucr. Quatuor naturæ, ex quibus omnia constant. Corpora principiorum. Rerum matrices, nutrices, populatrices. Elementaris mundi rotæ quatuor.
Elephas] Elephantus, Cic. Barrus, Hor. Bos luca, Plin. Turres armatorum, Id.

Elicere aliquem] Elicere aliquem ad aliquid præmiis. Invitare voluptatibus, Cic. Electare aliquid (scil. ab aliquo) Plaut. Carminibus clausas excantare puellas, Propert. Evocare aliquem præmiis, Quint. Delectare hostem, Non. Extrahere serpentes cantu, Plin.

page.notes: The brace group ("Non est in tanto / Nulla in tam magno est" with "corpore mica salis.") is set as a verse couplet beside a brace; the text is reproduced as printed. Catchword "Elices," is at the foot right. Some letters in the left margin edge and the scan's faint show-through were disregarded.
